'''YVH 8 S-series battle droids''' also known as space assault models, were the latest versions of the [[YVH 1]] [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]]. [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] deployed several during an assault on [[Marvid Qreph|Marvid]] and [[Craitheus Qreph]]'s [[Base Prime]].<ref name="Crucible (novel)" />
